verdict.rationale: Render's docs describe scaling features on the same service and datastore primitives: load-based autoscaling for 100x bursts, managed databases with read replicas and high availability, background workers 'at scale', and a single Blueprint YAML that defines the whole architecture. A community user corroborates autoscaling and Docker support. However, the evidence only implies a no-migration growth path rather than stating or demonstrating it. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or case study showing the same APIs and primitives carry from prototype to massive scale without rearchitecting, independent hands-on reports of very-large-scale workloads staying on Render, and documented scale limits or ceilings.
